title: Compiler Hints
summary: Uses query hints to surface compiler hint/warning findings that have been imported into the index, filtered by code or severity
intro: Read this when you want to review compiler hints and warnings without running a build. Compiler Hints lists the ones already imported into the index, filterable by hint code or severity.

steps: Choose drag-lint > Code Quality > Compiler Hints...
Optionally filter by hint code or severity
The imported hints and warnings are listed

questions.ask: Which compiler hints and warnings are already imported into the index?
Show only one hint code or one severity
